_why: THUNDERWAVE, cast by a wizard into a crowd. The Force-Weaver preset keeps three of its own spells and its fourth slot is swapped to Thunderwave, with the book flags swapped alongside it (a preset writes slots directly and then runs prepare_auto_fill, so the head is already packed with the spell that used to be there, and prepare_count correctly drops anything carried that the book no longer holds). The Squad Test puts three enemies on the field. Expect: the option offered only while something is Engaged, ONE shared 2d8 roll, full damage and a push one range step back for each enemy that fails its Constitution save, half and no push for each that makes it.
